name: Dark Luxury
signature: Near-black page, ivory serif, gold hairlines, slow cinematic fades.

contrast.note: Dark theme. Gold is safe as text on both backgrounds. Dark labels on gold buttons pass AA.

type.eyebrow: 0.75rem, weight 600, uppercase, 0.28em tracking, gold, with a 40px gold hairline before it

motion.rule: Cinematic: everything fades in over 1100ms with a 150ms stagger and no movement, and only the hero photo drifts with parallax.
use: data-parallax on the hero photo at 0.1

hero.layout: Full-viewport dark photo with a vignette, a 1px gold frame inset 16px from the edges, headline bottom-left in ivory, one outlined gold button. Scroll cue is a thin vertical gold line.
hero.photo: Real, well-lit photo of the finished work; must be dark enough for the ivory headline.

background: Near-black with a faint vignette on photo sections. Gold 1px hairlines separate sections. No patterns, no cards with fills: use hairline-bordered boxes.

button.fill: Primary: gold fill, dark label. Secondary: 1px gold outline, ivory label.
button.label: Body sans, weight 600, uppercase, 0.16em tracking.
button.hover: Press feedback only; the gold fill never animates.
